## What's new

Threadnote 5.3.8 makes pull request watching more flexible and improves recovery across development workflows.

### Watch pull requests independently

You can start an event-driven watch for an existing GitHub pull request without creating a Threadnote development workflow. A candidate pull request can also be observed before validation, and follow-up pull requests get separate watches.

### Continue and recover workflows

Development workflows can recover an unreviewed snapshot after a rebase with fresh review and validation, and recover an invalid review tail after its base advances. Completed local cycles can attach an authorized pull request while preserving their original completion record. Compact workflows retain their pull request delivery mode when a plan is reconciled.

Snapshot capture has more time to handle large checkouts and reports the comparison basis when the changed-path limit is exceeded. Workflow continuation and operator diagnostics are also clearer.
